prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGES (attached in this order):
Image 1 = approved style of this game: match its palette, dark navy outline, cel shading and the flat pale-cyan light details exactly
Image 2 = this character as it is in the game now: keep its silhouette, face and parts layout

STYLE BIBLE v2 (cyber datacenter): hand-drawn comic-book 2D game art, chunky readable cartoon shapes, cel shading with 2-3 hard-edged tones and grain; even medium-weight ink outline in very dark navy (#061018) around every object and major interior forms.
Palette: almost-black blue-teal bodies and metals (#071016, #0e1a22, #1a2a33, #2a3a44), matte, low saturation; light-emitting details (screens, LED strips, edge strips, indicator dots, power cores, cable ends) painted as FLAT pale cyan (#bff8ff) or pale mint (#c9fff0) shapes with a thin cyan (#00e5ff) border, no glow; warning details only in yellow (#ffd600) with black stripes; nothing warm, no brown, no beige, no orange metal.
Light: dim cool ambient from above, key from the upper left, lit faces only slightly lighter; the cyan details are the brightest areas; no cast shadows painted on the ground.
Strict top-down 3/4 view, camera about 50 degrees above the ground, orthographic, objects show their top and their front face.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no glow, no light rays, no cast shadows, no frame.

ASSET:
Use case: a character PART SHEET for cut-out rig animation in a top-down 3/4 survivors-like game set inside a dark cyberpunk datacenter.
Image 1 is the approved style of this game: match its near-black blue-teal bodies, very dark navy outline, chunky cartoon shapes, cel shading and flat light details exactly.
Image 2 is this character as it is in the game now: keep its exact silhouette, proportions, face, parts and their layout on the sheet; only repaint it.
Subject: the Mondelez client: a wide oval candy-wrapper plate creature.
Repaint: the big body surfaces become dark blue-teal plates like the machines in Image 1, but the BRAND COLOURS (purple and pink) are mandatory and strong:
a THICK frame in the brand colour all around the main body plate (as thick as in Image 2), brand-coloured stripes or cuffs on every leg, arm and shoe,
and brand-coloured details on the face plate. Together the brand colour covers about a third of what you see. Use exactly these brand colours, saturated
and flat; never replace them with cyan or teal (cyan is reserved for the hero). The character must be recognisable by colour alone from far away.
Keep any plain flat area on the body plain (the game prints the emblem there). Light details are flat colour shapes, not glowing.
Keep the same parts layout as Image 2 (body on top; below it, left to right: leg, foot, arm), every part separate with very wide empty gaps.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no numbers, no ground, no shadow, no glow.

Canvas: 1536x1024 px (3:2 landscape); if that exact size is unavailable, use the closest size with the same aspect ratio.

Background: fully transparent (real alpha channel, PNG) everywhere outside the ASSET, with clean anti-aliased edges; no ground or cast shadow beyond what the ASSET describes, no frame, no checkerboard pattern
